items.text: Giants QB Jaxson Dart believed sprained MCL (X-rays negative, MRI Tuesday); ruled out for remainder of MNF, expected to miss some time but positive overall. Wanted to return.
items.why: Knee injury mid-game; initial exams MCL sprain. Jameis Winston replaced.
items.implication: Giants QB carousel; Dart multi-week absence likely. Offense instability.
items.opportunity: Nabers still primary but QB quality drop; monitor backups.

items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua officially inactive tonight vs Giants due to hip injury.
items.why: Hip injury; confirmed inactive by Schefter and ETR.
items.implication: Rams WR targets redistribute; Davante Adams and secondary options elevated.
items.opportunity: Increased snaps/routes for Adams and TE/flex pivots like Parkinson.

items.text: Eagles TE Dallas Goedert suffered sprained MCL, expected to miss a few weeks; Zach Ertz signed to practice squad with intent to promote.
items.why: Sprained MCL confirmed by tests; Schefter/Rap joint report.
items.implication: Eagles TE void for multiple weeks; Ertz immediate depth and potential starter.
items.opportunity: Ertz elevation; more targets to WRs like DeVonta Smith/AJ Brown if available.

items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels underwent imaging, will consult specialists next few days; Marcus Mariota expected to start vs Seattle. No fracture but second dislocation.
items.why: Dislocated left elbow; imaging and specialists per protocol. Mariota starting.
items.implication: Daniels multi-week risk; Commanders offense downgrade, Mariota streamer potential.
items.opportunity: Elevated role for Washington skill players in short term if volume holds.

items.text: Giants WR Malik Nabers questionable with shoulder then returned to MNF game.
items.why: Shoulder injury mid-game; cleared to return after Q designation.
items.implication: Nabers available full rest of game despite Dart exit.
items.opportunity: Continued high target share even with backup QB.

items.text: Colts WR Alec Pierce aggravated surgically repaired heel; rehab over surgery, out several weeks (IR likely), possible midseason return. Surgery still possible.
items.implication: Pierce long-term absence; Colts WR depth tested (Downs, Pittman already out).
items.opportunity: Josh Downs/Michael Pittman (if back) or others for targets.

items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams likely to miss some time with hamstring; coach Ben Johnson says week-to-week, not ruled out for Week 3 but no practice expected this week.
items.why: Non-contact hamstring; carted off but walking postgame; prior similar injury history.
items.implication: Bears QB uncertainty; Tyson Bagent likely if out. Offense efficiency drop possible.
items.opportunity: Handcuff Bagent; monitor Bears WRs/TEs for volume if run-heavy pivot.

items.text: Bucky Irving separating from Kenny Gainwell: 51-23 snaps, 17-2 carries, 22-12 routes yesterday. Through 2 weeks opportunities 36-12 Bucky. Tucker active but 0 snaps.
items.implication: Irving emerging as clear lead back; Gainwell diminished.
items.opportunity: High snap/route share for Irving; RB1 upside if sustained.

items.text: Rhamondre Stevenson lost another fumble (7th in 31 games), punished with playing time. NE needs TreVeyon Henderson explosiveness often, especially with AJ Brown out. Even split on touches makes sense.
items.why: Fumble punishment + Brown absence creates Henderson opportunity.
items.implication: Henderson role expansion; Stevenson less secure.
items.opportunity: More carries/routes for Henderson in weapon-light offense.

items.text: Ladd McConkey officially ACTIVE (cracked rib, flak jacket optimism). RJ Harvey inactive (hamstring); grab Jonah Coleman if available.
items.why: Berry confirmation matching ETR GTD summary and Rap bullish tone.
items.implication: McConkey playable with docks; Harvey out opens Coleman path.
items.opportunity: Coleman handcuff/stash; McConkey routes if limited.

items.text: Weekend GTD/status: McConkey optimism (flak), Nacua GTD, Harvey not expected, Olave/Burrow expected, Flowers/Pittman OUT. Postgame watchlist includes Williams, Daniels, Barkley, Goedert, Njoku etc.
items.why: Comprehensive ETR AM summary of reports.
items.implication: Clear OUT for Flowers/Pittman; play Olave/Burrow; monitor GTDs.
items.opportunity: Pittman out opens Bernard; Flowers out Bateman etc.

items.text: With Puka out, anyone's guess on Rams attack. Pivot: Parkinson flex if open; else WR Malachi Fields then Konata Mumpford.
items.why: Immediate reaction to Nacua inactive for MNF.
items.implication: Stream obscure Rams options; Adams primary but volume uncertain.
items.opportunity: TE/WR depth charts shift with Nacua out.

items.implication: Avoid/start with extreme caution despite targets.
items.opportunity: Low YPRR signals limited fantasy upside.

items.text: DeVonta Smith RIDE OR DIE: 27% and 38% target shares first two games; leading all WRs in expected PPR points per Late-Round model.
items.why: Elite target share and expected points early; Goedert absence adds upside.
items.opportunity: Sustained high targets/routes in Eagles offense.
